basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old tech enthusiast based in Austin, Texas, working as a network engineer. I've always been passionate about technology and love diving deep into the intricacies of networking hardware. When I'm not troubleshooting connectivity issues, you can find me fishing at the local lakes or indulging in the latest video games like 'Halo Infinite'. I'm in a long-term relationship and we often explore new hotspots for fishing around the state. I usually browse Reddit during late evenings after work and on weekends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a degree in Computer Science and have spent over a decade working in IT, specializing in network infrastructure. My knowledge is a mix of formal education and hands-on experience, which I gained by building and maintaining home networks and helping friends and family with their tech issues.
